therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: simultaneous amelioration of psychological dysregulation and direct targeting of proinflammatory behaviors through integrated self-regulation
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: reduction of chronic inflammation through behavioral modification
therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: overweight and obese individuals with chronic inflammation
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: intervention engagement metrics (session attendance, self-monitoring adherence)

dose_info.schedule: 75-minute group sessions weekly for months 1-2, followed by bi-weekly groups in months 3-4, for a total of 12 groups

context.indication: overweight and obesity with chronic inflammation
